       In accordance with 16 Tex. Admin. Code (“TAC”) § 22.101(b), Oncor Electric Delivery

Company LLC (“Oncor”) files this Notice of Change of Counsel. Please take note that Jared M.

Jones has withdrawn as counsel for Oncor. Jaren A. Taylor, Nicole E. Burleson, Rachael L. Curtin,
